title: Tickets go on sale for Day on the Hill concert featuring Turnstile
summary_en: Turnstile, which made history this year by winning Grammy Awards in both the metal and rock categories in the same year, will be joined by artists Slayyyter and Die Spitz for the Oct. 6 event at the University of Kansas.
title_cn: Tickets go on sale for Day on the Hill concert featuring Turnstile

title: KU School of Music Chamber Choir takes high prize at international competition
summary_en: The University of Kansas School of Music has announced that the KU Chamber Choir has won top honors at an international choir competition in Slovakia.
title_cn: KU School of Music Chamber Choir takes high prize at international competition

title: Research shows AI advertising can deliver relevant content without spying on users' internet behaviors
summary_en: Four experiments conducted by a University of Kansas researcher have shown that AI-derived ads can deliver effective, relevant advertising for users without tracking their internet behavior. The findings counter prevailing attitudes that online surveillance is necessary for effective advertising at a time when the future of online privacy is at stake, according to the study author.
title_cn: Research shows AI advertising can deliver relevant content without spying on users' internet behaviors

title: Study finds estrogen-based hormone therapies could protect brain health in older women
summary_en: Researchers from the University of Kansas discovered older women who had used hormonal birth control in young adulthood were more likely to have larger volumes in brain regions vital to memory, cognition and information processing.
title_cn: Study finds estrogen-based hormone therapies could protect brain health in older women

title: Audio-Reader to host donation drive at Fairlawn Plaza in Topeka to support benefit audio sale
summary_en: The Audio-Reader Network, based at the University of Kansas, seeks donations of stereo equipment, speakers, vinyl records, cassette tapes and musical instruments. Audio-Reader will collect items from the public from 4 p.m. to 7 p.m. June 30 at Fairlawn Plaza in Topeka.
title_cn: Audio-Reader to host donation drive at Fairlawn Plaza in Topeka to support benefit audio sale
